_readme: Personal PII inventory. COPY to ~/.config/sensitive-canary/config.json (or point $SENSITIVE_CANARY_CONFIG at your copy), replace every EXAMPLE value with the real one, chmod 600 the copy. NEVER commit real values: this template stays inert (its values match nothing you will type). See PERSONAL-INVENTORY.md. All rules are category pii, so findings become obvious __CANARY_*__ tokens and [allow-pii] bypasses them.

rules.description: Your handles, comma-free exact matches (add one rule per handle if they differ)
Your GitHub profile URLs (public-repo references to others still pass)
Home SSID, personal domains, other named networks (exact match)
Employer ticket keys: pin YOUR prefix (a bare [A-Z]+-\d+ would fire on CVEs and error codes)
